acv.quote: Two hundred and fifty K ACV.

header.reason: Halima, the COO, picked the rival because they named who would pick up on on-sale day. Our support tiers sounded like 'a queue with a faster timer.' Jordan thought the load test had won it.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with what happens when payments fail mid on-sale.
findings.why: Payments failed four minutes into a Friday on-sale. The old provider replied to a ticket after it ended.
findings.quote: payments started failing about four minutes in

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Write for the COO who owns on-sale day, not the CTO.
findings.why: Ben, the CTO, wanted us. Halima decided in one meeting and only said 'good' to the load test.
findings.quote: it was Halima's call and she made it in one meeting.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Say who covers a big on-sale, not just throughput and bots.
findings.why: Ben said the rival brought named people. Afterward, Tixhaven's questions moved from throughput to names.
findings.quote: Before that meeting it was throughput, queueing, bots. After, it was names.

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Change support tiers and response times into named people who answer.

line.text: Enterprise support: a technical account manager embedded in your team, with a 15-minute response for critical issues

findings.why: When Halima asked 'who's my person,' Jordan explained tiers and response times. She dismissed it.
findings.quote: so it's a queue with a faster timer.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a written on-sale morning plan showing who watches and who answers.
findings.why: Halima asked to see on paper what we do at minute four. We had nothing to show.
findings.quote: She wanted to see, on paper, what we do on an on-sale morning.

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'what happens when it's down' instead of uptime or support.
findings.why: Halima brushed off uptime. Jordan noted that nobody at Tixhaven used the word 'support'.
findings.quote: I don't buy uptime, I buy what happens when it's down.
